t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Good gnomes give 5 or more mushrooms. One gnome will give a better amount of mushrooms for a while, but after a while, the rule may change (e.g., the colour of the gnome who gives more mushrooms). It's a good idea to try and figure out the rule using trial and error to work out which new gnome will give the best amount of mushrooms. The rules also seem to change after the breaks.

vb_textbox.text: Good gnomes give 5 or more mushrooms. Through trial and error in the first few rounds, you can figure out which colour of gnome is the "better" option out of the two gnomes in each round. Sometimes, associating similar colours (like brown, pink, and red) are a good way to remember which gnomes are better if these gnomes are giving more points! Or if blue, red, and green gnomes appear to give more points, it's good to remember that the brighter colours will give you a brighter chance of getting more points! It seems as though the rules change at random, particularly after breaks. Try out your original method for the first round, and if this is no longer holding true, flip the rules on their head! Good luck!
